newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: Lithuanian shares inch up in slow trade.
newsitem.headline: Lithuanian shares inch up in slow trade.

text.p: Lithuanian shares inched up on Monday but trading remained dull, dealers said.
Overall central market volume was 603,000 litas and the group A index rose by 27.39 points to 2,395.52.
Dealers say they expect more activity after a series of shareholders' meetings and company results later this month.
The bourse has been flagging since a brief bull run in January which pushed shares to record highs.
Birzai Dairy's shares were in relative demand in turnover of 108,000 litas at the unchanged price of ten litas.
Lithuania Gas was unchanged at 2.03 litas in trade of 130,000 litas.
Gainers included Kaunas Milk, which saw its price jump by ten percent to 4.29 litas in trade of 1,630 litas.
Naftas terminalas rose by eight percent to 108 litas in light trade of 540.00 litas.
Block trades worth 1.28 million litas were also made on Monday but no transactions were recorded on the secondary T-bill market.
